steps.text: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C); prepare a 9x13 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray.
Whisk together the sugar, soy sauce, and garlic powder in a medium bowl. Arrange the wings in the bottom of the prepared dish; pour the soy sauce mixture evenly over the wings.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes; turn the wings over with a spatula and cook another 20 minutes.

review.reviewBody: I thought theses were great wings, not what i'm used too, but so simple to make and very tasty!!! Not a big fan of using large wings, i'm a drummette kind of girl. Also, I don't think people should be leaving 3 stars for a recipe they have never tried, seems odd to me. Thanks for the recipe!!!!!!!

This is a great recipe with a few modifications. Most reviewers suggested adding garlic/onion. I used drumsticks. I added approx 3 tsp minced garlic, a chopped onion, approx 1 tsp garlic powder and 1 tsp onion powder. I then marinated them overnight in the mixture. After laying them out on a foil lined baking sheet, I poured the extra marinade over them. I baked them approx 25 mins per side. They cooked through perfectly. I served these to a group of 15 teenagers and got rave reviews. They came back for more! Always a good sign. Thanks for sharing.

These turned out great, and disappeared from the bowl! I did modify by only using 3/4 cup sugar, low sodium soy sauce, at least 1/2 teaspoon of garlic and onion powder. I microwaved the sauce about 1 minute to help the sugar dissolve. I bought a 4 lbs bag of wings and added the sauce to the bag as it was thawing. Plenty of sauce! Thanks for a great recipe!

Great recipe. It was a little too sweet for me but the kids loooved it. The second time I cut the sugar to 3/4 a cup and it was perfect and added a little more garlic and some lemon pepper. Just depends on your taste. The kids loved it the second time too lol. Will definitely continue to make again and again.

These are my "go-to" appetizer recipe - I have made them for family gatherings and major events. Marinate overnight or at least several hours and DO use lots of fresh garlic. Use white pepper for a bit more zing. There are NEVER any "survivors" on the serving platter when serving these, LOL.

These are soooooo good. I made a few changes, but I'm guessing these would taste about the same as is. I used tenderloins instead of wings, which only require 25 minutes to cook. I also used fresh garlic (way more than a "dash") and reduced the sauce first. Delightful!

I tried this recipe, and changed a few things because I had no soy sauce. I added teriyaki instead, put in pepper and onion powder, but then only dipped it in the sauce before cooking it. My family loves BBQ, so after they were done I BBQ's them on broil in the oven. Even without the BBQ sauce, they were great! I tried one without the BBQ sauce, and it was wonderful. I would definitely make this again.

I made these exact to the recipe given and they were delicious! I have since changed it up a bit. I add garlic and freshly crushed pineapple (a can of crushed pineapple when in a pinch). Always a hit and never have leftovers!

These wings are amazing! I do suggest seperating the wings before cooking or just buy the ones already seperated. I served with white rice and it was a fabolous meal! The second time I made them I used boneless chicken breast and they were absolutely delicious! My finace loves them and I will be making these again and again!

These are delicious! The first time I made these I made them exactly as the recipe says. They were a little bland so the next time I made them I upped the garlic and added onion powder. They were very flavorful. I make them every year for our annual halloween party, my daughters insist:)

I worked my way around the recipe. I used soy sauce,brown sugar, cayenne and garlic salt. The first thing that I did was soak the wings in coco cola for an hour and cooking for 25 mins. On each side. We shall see if the family likes it. I'm sure they will
These wines were just perfect!!! Everyone couldn’t stop eating them. There was not a single wing left. Followed the recipe exactly to the T. Will def make these again
This was really good. I cooked all the chicken parts not just the wings.

What a simple, easy to make, Great recipe. I think I will marinate them in the sauce overnight before I cook them in the sauce to enhance the flavor. I was generous with the garlic powder. My kids scarfed these up. I added them as a main dish, and also an appetizer. I will use this with drumsticks too. A big hit!
Took this to an office pot luck for Halloween. It was not good.

My family members and friends love this chicken! It's sticky but sweet, tangy and has that gooey feel where you would just lick your fingers and ask for more. I either added or changed some ingredients for specific groups of people I made the dish for but the chicken still came out great each time.
served this at our Halloween party, they were a huge hit. Didn't change a thing!

I made these last night for dinner after marinating overnight. Also made them on a baking sheet lined with no-stick foil so cleanup was a breeze. The only reason there were leftovers was because I was home alone and couldn't eat all 2 pounds myself. Great with ranch dressing! I'll definitely make these again!!
These are so simple but surprisingly delicious! WoW
